senses.gloss:
mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Purchased with twenty.
E.
विंशतिक relating to twenty, अण् aff.

n. (-कं)
A vessel for holding or pouring ghee, used at sacrifices with fire.

m. (-यः)
A name of GARUḌA.
E.
विनता the mother of this being, and ढक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Relating to morals or behaviour.
2 Enforcing proper conduct.
3 Magisterial.
E.
विनय, and ठक् aff.
m. (-कः)
A chariot used formerly in battle, a war carriage.
E.
वि before णी to get, अण् aff., and ठक् added.

m. (-कः)
A Bauddha, a follower of Buddha.
E.
विनायक a Buddha or teacher of this sect, ठक् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A dependant, a subject, a slave.
2 A spider.
3 An astrologer.
E.
विनाश loss, destruction, aff. ठञ्.

mn. (-कः-कं)
A mediate conveyance, as a porter carrying a letter, a horse dragging a chariot, &c.
E.
वि variously, णी to take, aff. क्त, with कन् and अण् added.
